rule: Screens are split into a pre-monsoon (January-June) and a monsoon (July-December) calendar; an episode belongs to the calendar of its start month. A calendar is flagged in a year when its rainfall is at or above the 80th percentile of that calendar's rainfall in every earlier year with a value (at least 8 earlier years). Rainfall is the analysis pipeline's own gridded series, averaged over the tile's cells; the pre-monsoon values are the pipeline's Jan-May totals because no June-only series exists.

sources.episodeRule: Catalogue records inside a tile that start within 10 days of an episode's first record and within 150 km of it join that episode.
sources.events: GDACS flood alerts (UN/EU), every alert level, inside the three tiles.
